# NovaTools (toolboxs.tech)

> NovaTools is a 100% client-side, privacy-first media, document, PDF, video, audio, SVG, and diagram utility suite. Every tool executes locally inside the user's browser using WebAssembly (WASM), Web Workers, WebCodecs, WebGPU, HTML5 Canvas, and on-device neural AI. Zero files are ever uploaded to remote servers.

- Website: https://toolboxs.tech/
- XML Sitemap: https://toolboxs.tech/sitemap.xml
- About: https://toolboxs.tech/about
- Privacy Policy: https://toolboxs.tech/privacy
- Terms of Service: https://toolboxs.tech/terms
- Contact: https://toolboxs.tech/contact

## Core Suites

- [PDF Suite](https://toolboxs.tech/pdf): Merge, Split & Extract, Rotate, AES Password Protect, Redact & Flatten, PDF to Images, Images to PDF, Page Numberer & Stamper, PDF to Word (DOCX), and Word to PDF.
- [Image Suite](https://toolboxs.tech/image): AI Background Remover, Format Converter (WebP, AVIF, PNG, JPG, ICO), Smart Compressor with real-time diff, Resizer, EXIF Metadata Scrubber, and SVG Optimizer.
- [Video & Audio Suite](https://toolboxs.tech/video): YouTube/TikTok/Discord Video Compressor, Trimmer & Cutter, Audio Extractor, Video Muter, AI Subtitle Generator (Whisper ASR .SRT/.VTT), Audio Volume Booster (+12 dB with limiter), Video to GIF Maker, Animated Lyrics Video Generator (16:9, 9:16 TikTok/Shorts, 1:1), and AI Voice Studio (Kokoro-82M TTS).
- [Document & AI Suite](https://toolboxs.tech/document): Universal Document Studio, Markdown to PDF, Markdown to Word (DOCX), Document to Slides (PPTX), Document to Excel (XLSX), and Word to PDF.
- [Diagram & Visualizer Suite](https://toolboxs.tech/diagram): AI Document-to-Diagram Studio, Document to Flowchart, Document to Database ERD, and Document to Architecture Map.
- [SVG Tools](https://toolboxs.tech/svg): AST-based SVG optimization and 1-click React/JSX component export.

## Privacy & Technical Architecture

- **Zero Server Uploads**: Files remain in local browser RAM (`ArrayBuffer`) and never cross the network.
- **Hardware Acceleration**: Local CPU/GPU execution via WebGPU, WebCodecs, and multithreaded WebAssembly.
- **Free & Unlimited**: No accounts, no watermarks, no daily file limits.
